title: Austin Sells Ben's BBQ & Lots
summary:
*   Approved the sale of the Ben's BBQ property located at 900 E. 11th Street.
*   Also included in the sale were two adjacent vacant lots at 901 and 903 Juniper.
*   The property was sold to Ben's Long Branch BBB for $49,244.
*   The purchaser is responsible for covering all closing costs associated with the transaction.

BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 12, 1998
The Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened. The
following agenda item (set forth on the City of Austin Council Meeting agenda as item 52)
was considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors. 1.
Approve a resolution to authorize the sale of 900 E. 11th, Ben's BBQ, and the vacant lots
located at 901 Juniper and 903 Juniper to Ben's Long Branch BBB, in the amount of $49,244.
(All closing costs will be paid by the purchaser.) AHFC Resolution No. 980212-01 was
approved on Board Member Goodman's motion, Board
Member Spelman's second by a 7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned.
